decision_reason: The Rust profile and three value-tested outcomes prove a safe expansion foundation. Comment drift and one conventional Cargo library module move are supported; subsystem mapping provides a useful partial selected-configuration map; the other 19 jobs remain pending implementation, and tool or implementation gaps are never permanent unsupported judgments.

native_check: profile, Cargo boundary, and copied fixture only
skills.limitation: No Rust adapter artifact or explicit Cargo/non-Cargo/workspace/target selection outcome is validated.
No final audit associates comments with cfg-selected, macro-expanded, generated, or build-script behavior.

native_check: Cargo graph and rust-analyzer feasibility only
skills.limitation: Macro expansion, build outputs, cfg variants, trait dispatch, generics, unsafe/FFI, and compiler desugaring lack a final explanation artifact.
Variants, pattern-match exhaustiveness, serialization/FFI layout, feature gates, and compatibility evidence do not reach the proposal boundary.

exact positive, clean, decoy, role exclusion, partial/failure recovery, stale replacement, copied closure, source preservation, native test/format, and executable-smoke boundaries reach all four final artifacts
skills.limitation: One bounded adjacent percentage/rate doc-comment versus fixed-literal function-body rule; macros, build scripts, include!, cfg/target variants, traits, generics, unsafe/FFI, and runtime semantics remain explicit non-claims.

native_check: compiler and analyzer syntax feasibility only
skills.limitation: Macros, async desugaring, closures, match guards, generated code, and cfg variants lack an accepted counting policy and final report.
Imports/re-exports, macros, associated items, blanket impls, cfg variants, and generated identifiers lack complete identity resolution.

native_check: Cargo targets and explicit modules only
